Who we are
10+ Years of Trusted Bathroom Remodeling Excellence

Remont Remodel LLC has set the standard for kitchen, bathroom, and full-home renovations in Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, and Seattle for over a decade. Remont Remodel holds the Washington State General Contractor License REMONRL761D5, demonstrating full compliance with state construction standards. The company carries comprehensive liability insurance and maintains bonding coverage, ensuring financial and legal protection for every homeowner.

Each project is supported by workers’ compensation coverage, which safeguards both clients and crews. Remont Remodel delivers homeowners the peace of mind, professionalism, and regulatory compliance required for high-quality remodeling projects. We take a quality-over-quantity approach, focusing on a selected number of projects so every detail receives meticulous attention. Our white glove, turnkey service ensures your remodel is seamless and stress-free, from the initial design consultation to permitting, construction, and the
final walkthrough.

Remont Remodel delivers the perfect balance of precision craftsmanship and dependable project management, earning the trust of Eastside homeowners by turning complex projects into smooth, worry-free bathroom transformations.

Our Services
Complete Bathroom & Kitchen Remodeling Services
Bathroom Additions

Limited bathrooms quickly become a challenge if you’re part of a growing family or want to increase your property’s value. We solve this for you with custom bathroom additions, starting with a professional space assessment, securing all required permits, and coordinating plumbing and electrical integration. We manage every step of the build so you can enjoy an efficient layout and modern finishes, all completed within just a few weeks.

Bathroom Remodeling

An outdated bathroom can limit both your comfort and your style. We start bathroom remodeling with a design consultation focused on your goals, then move through efficient demolition, upgrades to your plumbing and lighting, and a modern redesign. The result is a bathroom that perfectly balances elegance and practicality, built to enhance your daily living and increase your home’s long-term value.

Full Bathroom Renovations

Our full bathroom renovations range from complete tear-outs and floorplan reconfiguration to new plumbing, electrical, and high-end finishes. Our turnkey process transforms bathrooms in 3 to 4 weeks, and we handle all permits and code requirements on your behalf.

Tub-to-Shower Conversions

A tub-to-shower conversion is one of the best ways to add accessibility and modern living to your home. We remove your outdated tub, design a custom shower layout, and add features like barrier-free entries, grab bars, and built-in seating. Most conversions are finished in just a few days, giving you comfort, safety, and an updated style in record time.

Walk-In Shower Installations

You can enjoy the perfect blend of accessibility and luxury with our walk-in showers. Your new shower features barrier-free entries, custom tilework, and sleek glass enclosures. We also offer ADA-compliant options designed to support your needs if you’re planning to age in place. Every installation is built with your safety, durability, and modern style in mind.

Custom Tile Work

When you choose our specialists for Custom tile renovations, you get precision installations that elevate your bathroom and kitchen. Whether you want intricate mosaics or luxury stone finishes, we combine expert waterproofing with flawless craftsmanship. The result is tilework that enhances your home’s style and long-term performance.

Kitchen Installations & Renovations

Transform your kitchen with our kitchen remodeling service into the modern, functional centerpiece you’ve always wanted. We handle everything for you, from cabinetry and countertops to plumbing, electrical, and appliance coordination. Whether you’re planning a full renovation or a new installation, we’ll manage the timeline, permits, and trades so your project is completed within weeks.

Full House Renovations

We specialize in guiding you through complex projects from start to finish if you’re planning a multi-room or full-home remodel. We’ll handle permits, manage timelines, and coordinate every trade involved. You can feel confident knowing your home transformation will be finished on time, on budget, and to the highest standard.

Service Areas

Remont Remodel provides reliable bathroom, kitchen, and whole-home renovations to homeowners and businesses across the Eastside and Greater Seattle area. Our service radius covers up to 25 miles from our Redmond, WA headquarters.

Our team reaches most local cities within 15 to 35 minutes, allowing us to provide both scheduled consultations and emergency bathroom repair services.

We offer:

Same-day estimates in Redmond, Bellevue, and Kirkland
Next-day consultations in Sammamish, Issaquah, and Seattle
Emergency bathroom repairs in Bellevue, Redmond, and Kirkland with a 30-minute response time.
Bathroom Remodel Permit Requirements in King County
Bellevue

Bathroom additions require residential building permits, ranging from $350 to $600. We maintain a 100% approval rate for submitted projects.

Redmond

Major remodels require plumbing and mechanical permits under Redmond Municipal Code Title 15, averaging $250 to $500. We coordinate directly with city inspectors to streamline approvals.

Kirkland

Layout changes and fixture installations require city permits, usually $300 to $550, and two required inspections. Cosmetic updates like tile replacement do not require permits.

Seattle

Complete bathroom renovations involving structural, plumbing, or electrical changes require construction permits that range from $400 to $900. Our team prepares drawings, submits paperwork, and schedules inspections to avoid costly delays.

Our Story
From Vision to Premier Eastside Contractor

Remont Remodel was founded with a simple mission: to transform homes with white-glove service that removes the stress and uncertainty from the remodeling process. More than ten years ago, we began serving homeowners across Seattle’s Eastside with a vision shaped by owner Viktor Chirkin: quality over quantity, craftsmanship over shortcuts, and customer trust above all else.

What started as a small local contracting business has become one of the Eastside’s premier remodeling companies. Our growth came not from chasing volume, but from consistently exceeding your expectations and building lasting relationships with you. Each project has been
a stepping stone in creating our reputation for precision work, transparent communication, and a commitment to turning renovation dreams into reality.

We understand that remodeling a home is more than a construction project; it’s deeply personal and often emotional. That’s why, at Remont Remodel, we focus on bathrooms and kitchens, the spaces that form the heart of every home. By listening closely to you and approaching every
detail with care, we’ve earned the trust of Eastside families who want remodeling done right, the first time. Our story is one of steady growth built on integrity, craftsmanship, and an unwavering dedication to creating spaces that truly feel like home

Meet Viktor Chirkin – Owner & Licensed General Contractor
Experience & Expertise

Viktor Chirkin is the driving force behind Remont Remodel. As a Licensed General Contractor in Washington State (License REMONRL761D5), Viktor brings over a decade of specialized experience in bathroom and kitchen renovations. He has personally overseen hundreds of projects across the Eastside, giving him a deep understanding of the region’s diverse home

Our Process
Our Process
001
Free Consultation & Assessment

The initial consultation lasts 60 to 90 minutes. During your first consultation visit, Remont Remodel measures and photographs your space, assesses current conditions, and evaluates structural or design challenges. The discussion focuses on your vision, functional needs, project timeline, and budget range. A professional assessment is provided, including preliminary recommendations and design considerations. By the end of the consultation, you will receive a clear understanding of the project scope and possibilities. The next step includes a detailed written estimate delivered within 24 to 48 hours. The consultation emphasizes professional guidance without sales pressure, allowing you to make informed decisions confidently.

002
Detailed Estimate & Design Planning

A comprehensive written estimate is provided within 24 to 48 hours after the consultation. This includes a detailed breakdown of materials, labor, and the projected timeline. Preliminary design and layout options are shared, highlighting quality material selections within the budget. We also identify and explain the permit requirements and associated costs. Up to two estimate revisions are included at no additional charge, ensuring transparency and flexibility. All pricing is clear, with no hidden costs. The estimate phase provides a concrete plan for construction, material sourcing, and design decisions, giving you confidence in your project before work begins.

003
Contract & Design Finalization

The contract is completed within one to two business days, detailing the project scope, timeline, and payment schedule. During this stage, we confirm the final design choices, including materials and fixtures. We submit and track permit applications. We will provide you with a confirmed project schedule and start date. A pre-construction walkthrough ensures all preparations are complete. All elements are finalized before construction begins, providing a clear roadmap for the remodeling project

004
Professional Construction & Installation

We carry out construction from 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Work areas are protected with floor coverings, dust barriers, and organized staging to maintain a safe and clean environment. We source premium materials, store them securely, and licensed, experienced craftsmen install them with precision. We share daily progress updates and photos with you, document milestones, and provide transparency throughout the process. Multi-point quality inspections verify adherence to standards. The job site is cleaned daily before departure. We communicate any issues or adjustments immediately to ensure smooth project flow. Problem-solving is handled promptly to maintain timelines and quality standards.

005
Final Inspection & Completion

A comprehensive walkthrough with a quality checklist confirms that all work meets our standards. You are welcome to review every detail before final cleanup and debris removal are completed. We provide documentation, including warranty information and maintenance guides. We offer ongoing support for your questions or future needs. The project is only closed once you have achieved your full satisfaction.

What Makes Our Process Different
White Glove Service Standards

Remont Remodel provides complete project management from start to finish. A single point of contact coordinates all aspects of the project. We conduct ourselves with respect for your home, schedule, and family routines and ensure minimum disruption to your daily life. All interactions are professional and courteous. Our quality-over-quantity approach ensures detailed attention and precision on every project.

Communication & Transparency

We provide you with daily updates via text, email, or phone and document progress and milestones through photos. Any issues or changes are communicated immediately. We have an open-door policy for your questions and concerns, and ensure satisfaction through regular check-ins. Don’t fear any surprise costs, as we keep pricing fully transparent.

Quality Assurance Program

Projects undergo multi-point quality inspections throughout each phase of bathroom or kitchen remodeling. Skilled craftsmen with specialized training perform all installations, and materials and workmanship meet industry-leading standards. We verify code compliance at every stage. A final quality checklist ensures completion standards are met, while a written warranty backs all work.

Our Story
Expert Bathroom Additions – 10+ Years of White Glove Service

Remont Remodel has specialized in bathroom additions for homeowners across the Eastside. We deliver a seamless experience from start to finish, whether you need an extra bathroom for a growing family, improved accessibility, or simply more convenience. 

Our white glove, turnkey approach covers everything from design and permitting to final inspection in Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, and Seattle, so you don’t have to worry. We guarantee every project is handled professionally and carefully as we are a licensed general contractor (REMONRL761D5), fully insured, and bonded. 

Our team, backed with 10+ years of experience, ensures your new bathroom blends perfectly with your home’s style with attention to detail, quality craftsmanship, and clear communication.

Our Process
Complete Bathroom Additions Process
001
Free Consultation & Assessment

Your bathroom addition starts with a free, no-obligation consultation, lasting 60 to 90 minutes. During this visit, we take precise measurements, document existing conditions with photos, and discuss your goals, preferences, and desired timeline. You’ll receive an overview of the process, preliminary recommendations, and clear next steps. This ensures your vision is fully understood before design begins, and you can make informed decisions without pressure.

002
Design & Planning

Our team presents custom bathroom addition design options tailored to your space, lifestyle, and budget. We guide you through material selection, highlighting durable, high-quality finishes that balance aesthetics and functionality. We handle the entire application process for you where permits are required. You’ll receive a written estimate with a detailed cost breakdown and revisions as needed until you’re delighted. Depending on complexity and scope, the design phase takes 5 to 10 days.

003
Professional Installation

Most bathroom additions take 3 to 6 weeks, depending on size and structural work required. We set a clear daily schedule, protect your home with dust barriers and floor coverings, and keep the site clean and organized. Our licensed tradespeople use quality materials and proven installation methods, ensuring lasting results. You’ll receive regular updates from your project manager so you always know what stage your addition is in. We work efficiently with minimal disruption to your daily routine.
